P_0x001EDA: A Holy Langran soldier. Once thought mediocre, believed to owe rank to lineage, he proved himself amid war's chaos, minimizing his own losses. Bold, yet solid tactically.
P_0x005D86: Chief of <Project TD>'s system dev team, keeping it running with backing from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. Caring, personable, yet capable of cold, rational judgment.
P_0x009095: One of Ruina's pseudo-life forms, the Meliorexe. To revive the "King of Ruin" she needs waves of negative emotion, so she pilots the Fortis Ala in repeated slaughter. Calm, merciless to those who defy her.
P_0x00ACD1: Key member of <SRX Project>; superb engineer, co-creator of <Personal Trooper>. A cold perfectionist, gets along with opposite Robert. Once wed to Marion.
P_0x00EEB5: Marshal of <Earth Fed Army>. A calculating strategist, sees the big picture, accepts good and ill. Dry, but loves sake and grandkids.
U_0x0173AA: A super <Elemental> designed by Xenia. Unlike normal <Elemental>s, it draws on Huckebein data for a distinct look. No spirit contract, but its pseudo-<Prana> generator lets a high-<Prana> pilot rival a <Masoukishin>. Tradeoff: short operating time.
U_0x00827E:
The R-Blade is <Mao Industries>' simplified mass-production prototype <Personal Trooper> based on R-1. It omits R-1's flight transform and <T-LINK System> (telekinesis sensor-amp) but performs well.
The R-Blade Custom refits prototype 3 for close combat, adding a <Tesla Drive>, Split Beam Cannon, and Wild Wurger's jacket armor.
U_0x00D259: A large space battleship used by <Earth Fed Army> and others, often a fleet flagship, with strong search and craft control. Made of a battle carrier bearing space fighters and <Armored Module>s, plus five beam-cannon ships, which can act alone or evacuate crew, used as missiles themselves.
